name: large-moe-inference-benchmark
description: A systems-oriented benchmark that measures inference performance and trade-offs for large mixture-of-experts (MoE) models across configurations and hardware. It evaluates metrics such as throughput, latency, memory footprint, and end-to-end inference behavior to inform deployment and optimization decisions. The benchmark compares different routing/expert-count setups and implementation backends to highlight performance and efficiency characteristics of large MoE deployments.
reputation: Niche benchmark used primarily by systems and ML infrastructure researchers for evaluating MoE inference performance; available on Hugging Face.
